consistencyLimits.status: consistency limits only; not benchmark acceptance thresholds

systemCpu.scope: whole machine during the sample span, including build/attestation and unrelated runner activity; not native-only CPU

limitations: The existing 2.5 s sample-start consistency bound is exceeded; all sequence indexes/durations are retained. This is a coverage diagnostic, not an automatic failed benchmark threshold.
No process start-time identity is recorded, so process lifetime/ownership cannot be verified from names or PIDs. Those details are excluded from this report.
QPC capture cost omits JSON serialization/write, sleeping, and final trace hash; it does not measure total observer CPU or overhead.
Whole-machine CPU is not proof of a quiet host. These observations do not measure scheduler/GPU duration or establish causal attribution.
No performance acceptance claim is made.

acceptancePolicy.reason: Policy review required: The base policy is not independently qualified; its verdict cannot establish a candidate pass.

privacyAndLimits: No raw hostnames, user paths, process receipts, or machine identifiers are included.
